1.reponse: She wants to apply for a job in marketing.
accepte: She wants to apply for a job in marketing.

2.reponse: a-3 (internship = stage), b-1 (scholarship = bourse), c-2 (deadline = échéance).

3.reponse: He applied to three universities and for one summer job.
accepte: He applied to three universities and for one summer job.

4.reponse: After school, I did an internship in a bank.
accepte: After school, I did an internship in a bank.
After school, I did a work placement in a bank.

6.reponse: The company advertised a vacancy for a graphic designer.
accepte: The company advertised a vacancy for a graphic designer.

8.reponse: I would be delighted to join your team. Thank you for your consideration.

criteres.idee: Remplacer « I really want » par une tournure polie (I would be delighted to join your team…)
Remplacer « thanks » par une formule (Thank you for your consideration)

9.reponse: She graduated from university with a degree in law and then found a job in a firm.

criteres.idee: La phrase utilise « to graduate » (graduated from…)
Elle utilise « a degree » (with a degree in…)
Elle décrit un parcours (études puis emploi…)

10.reponse: I am highly skilled in teamwork and time management. I always meet my deadlines, even under pressure.

criteres.idee: Emploi de « skilled » (I am highly skilled in…)
Emploi de « deadline » (I always meet my deadlines…)
Registre formel, phrases affirmatives valorisantes

11.reponse: une lettre de motivation ; un entretien d'embauche ; un(e) salarié(e).

criteres.idee: a cover letter = une lettre de motivation
a job interview = un entretien d'embauche
an employee = un(e) salarié(e)

12.reponse: a gap year ; tuition fees ; a scholarship.
accepte: a gap year, tuition fees, a scholarship
an internship and a work placement

30.reponse: He was hired after three interviews.
accepte: He was hired after three interviews.

32.reponse: My workload is too heavy this week.
accepte: My workload is too heavy this week.

33.reponse: He has been self-employed for two years.
accepte: He has been self-employed for two years.

35.reponse: Tuition fees are very expensive at this university. / She gave me some advice about coursework.

criteres.idee: fees est pluriel : Tuition fees are very expensive
advice est indénombrable : some advice (ou a piece of advice)

37.reponse: Familier : a boss, Thanks! ; formel : a supervisor, Thank you for your consideration.

criteres.idee: Familier : a boss, Thanks!
Formel : a supervisor, Thank you for your consideration

38.reponse: Exemple : Dear Sir or Madam, I am writing to apply for the position advertised on your website.

criteres.idee: Formule d'appel formelle : Dear Sir or Madam
Formule de candidature formelle : I am writing to apply for the position…

39.reponse: Un stage d'été en agence de voyages ; un CV et une lettre de motivation (avant le 30 mai).

criteres.idee: Le poste : un stage d'été dans une agence de voyages
Il faut envoyer un CV et une lettre de motivation
Avant le 30 mai

40.reponse: shortlisted = présélectionné ; commutes = fait le trajet domicile-travail.

criteres.idee: shortlisted = présélectionné (pour un entretien)
commutes = il fait le trajet domicile-travail

41.reponse: Année de césure, candidature à trois universités, spécialité en histoire.

criteres.idee: Anna a pris une année de césure
Elle a postulé à trois universités
Elle s'est spécialisée en histoire

43.reponse: a lecture : il concerne les études, pas le salaire.

criteres.idee: L'intrus est a lecture (un cours magistral) : il relève des études
a salary, wages, a raise concernent la rémunération

44.reponse: a vacancy : ce n'est pas une personne mais un poste à pourvoir.

criteres.idee: L'intrus est a vacancy : un poste à pourvoir
an applicant, a candidate, a trainee désignent des personnes

45.reponse: Exemple : During my internship in a bank, I learnt to work in a team and to meet deadlines.

criteres.idee: Mention d'un stage déjà effectué (internship, au passé)
Registre formel (ce qu'on y a appris : I learnt to…)

46.reponse: Exemple : Next year, I am going to apply to several universities. I would like to get a degree in engineering.

criteres.idee: Emploi de « to apply to » + université
Emploi de « a degree » (diplôme universitaire)
Présentation d'un projet d'orientation (next year, I would like…)

47.reponse: Currently, I'm doing an internship with a nice boss (manager).

criteres.idee: Actually = en fait : pour « actuellement », on dit currently
a stage → an internship
a patron → a boss (manager)

48.reponse: Exemple : Why do you want to join our company? — I would be delighted to join your team because I am highly skilled in communication.

criteres.idee: Une question de recruteur (Why do you want to join our company? …)
Une réponse au registre formel (I would be delighted…, I am highly skilled…)
